sql: with up as (select distinct device_id from marts.fct_device_event where event_code='FW_UPDATE' and firmware_version='1.1.0' and event_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-07') select round(avg(lte_loss_pct) filter (where firmware_version='1.0.0'),2) avg_lte_loss_100, round(avg(lte_loss_pct) filter (where firmware_version='1.1.0'),2) avg_lte_loss_110, count(*) n from marts.fct_device_daily where device_id in (select device_id from up) and not firmware_changed and lte_loss_pct is not null and event_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-07'

with up as (select distinct device_id from marts.fct_device_event where event_code='FW_UPDATE' and firmware_version='1.1.0' and event_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-07') select round(avg(lte_loss_pct) filter (where firmware_version='1.0.0'),2) avg_lte_loss_100, round(avg(lte_loss_pct) filter (where firmware_version='1.1.0'),2) avg_lte_loss_110 from marts.fct_device_daily where device_id in (select device_id from up) and not firmware_changed and lte_loss_pct is not null and event_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-07'
